newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths has A$800m credit facility.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths has A$800m credit facility.

text.p: Supermarket group Woolworths Ltd said on Tuesday it had accepted credit facility offers from nine Australian and foreign banks totalling A$800 million.

"These facilities will be utilised to replace facilities established since 1993 and to meet the company's projected capital requirements for ongoing new store, store refurbishment and major warehouse expansion plans," Woolworths said.
Woolworths said the bilateral revolving credit facilities were for an initial term of five years.

In February, Woolworths announced it would expand its wholesaling operations through its Australian Independent Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) unit which acquired last year as a part of its purchase of the Cannon group of stores.
Woolworths managing director Reg Clairs told Reuters the funds would also be used for the group's expansion into petrol retailing.
"Our move into the wholesaling is one area but we also have our plans for petrol retailing," Clairs said.
Woolworths said in November last year it hoped to achieve a one percent increase in sales from its shopping centres that had linked petrol outlets.
